_about: The controller's config (two-machine design), installed as /etc/ij-amd/controller.json by install-vm.sh. The installer writes it once and later only adds missing keys. The code has no default for driver.spend_cap_usd: with null the driver refuses to start a run.

judge._pool_note: each judged run draws `draw` rows per bucket (isl), each from a session never drawn before; rows come from ij-judge prepare-pool. 12 prompts a run (6 at 8000 and 6 at 12000 tokens) as set by the operator on 2026-11-18; agent sessions cannot be cut to 2000 or 4000

driver._size_and_region: fixed in ij-driver: gpu-mi350x1-288gb-spot in ric1
driver._price_usd_per_hour_note: null: DigitalOcean's price_hourly for the size (/v2/sizes); the driver refuses to create when it has no price

agent._goal_token_budget_note: the largest value Prime Agent 0.10.3 accepts (set by hand on the controller on 2026-11-18)
agent._command_note: as set by hand on the controller on 2026-11-18; a fresh root session each start (no --continue or --resume)
agent._settings_note: set in /home/agents/.prime/agent/settings.json at every install (controller/prime_settings.py), other keys kept. allowedModels is a limit Prime Agent enforces (it refuses any other model and fails closed on a wrong value); the selectors are the anthropic provider's ids in Prime Agent's model catalog (2026-11-18). agentTraces off and onboardingShown answer the first-run question about sharing traces (Not now)
